title: 第21章 噩梦缠身预知未来无力回天第22章 花灯寄情一念成约定三生
lines: 从扫地亭回来后，庄周的噩梦变得更加频繁也更加清晰。
以前他只是梦到四大战神战死的画面，现在他能梦到和谈现场的每一个细节，甚至能听到龟先生和五国君主的对话。
这天晚上，庄周又做了那个噩梦。
他梦到边境孤城的城门缓缓打开，龙国国君穿着龙袍，带着四大战神和文武百官走进了五国联军的包围圈。
龟先生站在城楼上，手中拿着一面黑色的令旗，脸上露出了狰狞的笑容。
“动手。”
龟先生猛地挥下令旗，十二道银色的星辰光柱冲天而起，在天空中形成了一个巨大的星阵，将整个孤城笼罩其中。
星阵启动的瞬间，龙国大军的灵力瞬间被封禁，所有人都变成了手无缚鸡之力的普通人。
五国联军发出了震天的喊杀声，朝着龙国大军冲了过去。
关羽手持青龙偃月刀第一个冲了上去。
“保护国君，杀出去。”
他大吼一声，挥舞着青龙偃月刀，斩杀了冲在最前面的几个黑日士兵。
但星阵不断抽取着他的肉身本源之力，他的动作越来越慢，力气也越来越小。
白羊座、金牛座、双子座三大星曜战神同时出手围攻关羽，关羽身中三百余箭，鲜血染红了他的绿色战袍，但他依旧死死地守在城门下，不让一个敌人过去。
“关将军，你已经尽力了，投降吧。”
白羊座星曜战神说道。
关羽吐出一口鲜血，怒目圆睁。
“我关羽生是龙国人，死是龙国鬼，绝不投降。”
说完，他用尽最后一丝力气，将青龙偃月刀插在城门之上，刀刃指向龙国的方向，然后缓缓倒下，至死都没有闭上眼睛。
“云长。”
吕布发出一声悲愤的怒吼，他手持方天画戟单骑冲入敌阵。
“我要你们为云长陪葬。”
吕布疯了一般挥舞着方天画戟，所到之处尸横遍野。
巨蟹座和狮子座星曜战神联手阻拦，被吕布一戟一个斩杀当场。
但十二星曜很快就布下了星力囚笼，将吕布困在其中。
星力不断侵蚀着吕布的身体，他的皮肤开始干裂，鲜血从毛孔中渗出，最终吕布力竭而亡，方天画戟断裂成两截，插在尸山血海之中。
“吕将军。”
项羽大吼一声，带着残部保护着国君朝着乌江畔突围。
“陛下，快渡江，我来断后。”
项羽说道。
国君摇了摇头，脸上露出了绝望的神色。
“朕是龙国的国君，朕不能走。朕走了，龙国的百姓怎么办？”
国君拔出佩剑横在脖子上。
“项羽，替朕告诉九州的百姓，朕对不起他们。”
content_en:
After returning from the Sweeping Pavilion, Zhuang Zhou's nightmares became more frequent and clearer.
In the past, he only dreamed of the four war gods dying in battle, but now he can dream of every detail of the peace talks, and can even hear the conversation between Mr. Turtle and the monarchs of the five countries.
That night, Zhuang Zhou had that nightmare again.
He dreamed that the gate of the isolated city on the border slowly opened, and the king of the Dragon Kingdom, wearing a dragon robe, walked into the encirclement of the five-nation coalition with the four war gods and hundreds of civil and military officials.
Mr. Turtle stood on the tower, holding a black flag in his hand, with a ferocious smile on his face.
"Do it."
Mr. Turtle waved his flag suddenly, and twelve silver star beams rose into the sky, forming a huge star array in the sky, covering the entire lonely city.
The moment the star array was activated, the spiritual power of the Dragon Kingdom army was instantly blocked, and everyone became ordinary people with no power to restrain themselves.
"Kill."
The five-nation allied forces made a loud killing cry and rushed towards the Dragon Kingdom army.
Guan Yu was the first to rush forward with the Qinglong Yanyue Sword in hand.
"Protect the king and kill him."
He roared, brandished the Qinglong Yanyue Sword, and killed several Black Sun soldiers who were rushing to the front.
But the star array continued to extract the original power of his body, his movements became slower and slower, and his strength became smaller and smaller.
The three war gods of Aries, Taurus, and Gemini attacked Guan Yu at the same time. Guan Yu was hit by more than three hundred arrows, and his green shirt was dyed red with blood, but he still stood firmly at the city gate, not letting any enemy pass.
"General Guan, you have done your best. Surrender."
The Aries Star God of War said.
Guan Yu spit out a mouthful of blood and his eyes widened in anger.
"I, Guan Yusheng, am from the Dragon Kingdom, and I will die as a ghost from the Dragon Kingdom. I will never surrender."
After saying that, he used his last bit of strength to insert the Qinglong Yanyue Sword on the city gate, pointing the blade in the direction of the Dragon Kingdom, and then slowly fell down, not closing his eyes until his death.
"Yun Chang."
Lu Bu let out a roar of grief and anger, and rode into the enemy formation alone with Fang Tian's painted halberd in hand.
"I want you to be buried with Yunchang."
Lu Bu waved Fang Tian's painted halberd like crazy, leaving corpses everywhere he went.
Cancer and Leo Xingyao Gods of War joined forces to stop them, but Lu Bu killed them one by one with a halberd.
But Twelve Stars quickly set up a star power cage, trapping Lu Bu in it.
Star power continued to erode Lu Bu's body, and his skin began to dry out and blood seeped out from his pores. Finally, Lu Bu died of exhaustion. Fang Tian's painted halberd broke into two pieces and was inserted into the sea of ​​​​blood on the mountain of corpses.
"General Lu."
Xiang Yu roared and led the remaining troops to protect the monarch and break out towards the Wujiang River.
"Your Majesty, cross the river quickly and I will cut off the queen."
Xiang Yu said.
The monarch shook his head, with a look of despair on his face.
"I am the king of the Dragon Kingdom, and I cannot leave. What will happen to the people of the Dragon Kingdom if I leave?"
The king drew his sword and placed it across his neck.
"Xiang Yu, tell the people of Jiuzhou for me that I am sorry for them."
title_en: Chapter 21: Nightmare haunts me and I can predict the future, and I am unable to recover from it. Chapter 22: A single thought of lanterns conveying love becomes a promise for three lives.
